literal: having shared food having accustomed him hunger which is called evil disease touching is rare
translation: The evil disease called hunger will rarely touch the man who is accustomed to sharing his food.
modern: தன்னிடமுள்ள உணவை மற்றவர்களுடன் பகிர்ந்து உண்ணும் பழக்கம் உள்ளவனை, பசி என்று சொல்லப்படும் கொடிய நோய் தீண்டுவது இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the protective power of generosity. The phrase 'பாத்து ஊண் மரீஇ' describes someone who has made it a habit to share their food before eating. The poet personifies hunger as an 'evil disease' (தீப்பிணி), highlighting its destructive nature. However, this disease will rarely touch (தீண்டல் அரிது) the one who shares, suggesting that a generous person will always be provided for and protected from starvation.
